name: Earth Boys Are Easy
source:
Earth Boys Are Easy is the story of Luke, a lonely eggplant farmer whose life is changed by some out-of-this-world visitors.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/stupidlullabies/status/1055859282678296576]Twitter[/url]]
translation:
《地球男孩很好骗》讲述孤独的茄子农民卢克，他的生活因来自外太空的访客而改变。

[来源：[url=https://twitter.com/stupidlullabies/status/1055859282678296576]Twitter[/url]]
